name: RMAN Block Media Recovery 诊断
description: Block Media Recovery (BMR) 修复单个或少量损坏块，无需恢复整个数据文件。常见场景包括物理损坏（ORA-01578）、NOLOGGING 操作导致备库坏块。

root_causes.name: 物理介质损坏
root_causes.desc: 磁盘坏道/控制器错误导致数据块不可读。

root_causes.name: NOLOGGING 操作后备库坏块
root_causes.desc: 主库 NOLOGGING direct path load 后备库对应块损坏。corruption_type = NOLOGGING。

root_causes.name: 内存损坏写入磁盘
root_causes.desc: RAM 错误导致 buffer cache 数据被篡改后写入。

root_causes.name: Oracle Bug 导致逻辑损坏
root_causes.desc: 特定版本 Bug 导致写入异常数据。

root_causes.name: 异步 I/O 问题
root_causes.desc: 异步 I/O 未正确完成导致部分写入（fractured block）。

oltp.desc: OLTP 任何坏块都是高优先级

olap.desc: OLAP 历史分区坏块可降低优先级

step1_check_corruption_list.sql: SELECT file#, block#, blocks, corruption_change#, corruption_type FROM v$database_block_corruption ORDER BY file#, block#

step2_identify_objects.sql: SELECT e.owner, e.segment_name, e.segment_type, c.file#, c.block#, c.corruption_type FROM v$database_block_corruption c JOIN dba_extents e ON c.file# = e.file_id AND c.block# BETWEEN e.block_id AND e.block_id + e.blocks - 1

step3_check_nologging.sql: SELECT file#, block#, blocks, corruption_type FROM v$database_block_corruption WHERE corruption_type = 'NOLOGGING'

step4_check_backup_availability.desc: 检查坏块文件是否有备份
step4_check_backup_availability.sql: SELECT file#, MAX(completion_time) last_backup FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE file# IN (SELECT DISTINCT file# FROM v$database_block_corruption) GROUP BY file#
